note: THE HIRING PIPELINE IS A DECLARATION. SmartPRS 2's RecruitmentController (rev 60) carries the stages, approval states, interview modes and recommendations as PHP constants, so a customer who screens in two rounds or wants a 'shortlisted' stage needs a release. Here they are data. The ORDER of `stages` is the order a candidate moves in; `terminal` stages end the pipeline; `hire_from` names the stage a hire may be made from.

requisition.approval_steps_note: Owner, 12 Oct 2026: a requisition is approved by the respective department's Director or the Branch Admin, then by HR Admin. Each step: the status the requisition sits in while waiting, its label, and the login roles that decide it; "department" / "branch" means only for the requisition's own department / location, "" means any. A final approver (config/approval-authority.json: Company Admin, HR Admin / HR Manager, administrator) approves at any step and that approval is final.

offer_rejected_note: Owner, 22 Oct 2026: a candidate who was offered and turned it down is marked Offer Rejected with a reason (from this list) and a note. Only from the offer stage.
drive_note: Owner, 22 Oct 2026: Hiring Drives. Imported invitees become candidates (source below, against the drive's requisition, else the talent pool). On the day, saving a row moves the candidate in the Pipeline: attended → drive_outcome_stage.attended, then the outcome's stage (forward only, one step at a time; rejected needs the reason, which is the row's notes or a default). A stage of "" leaves the candidate where they are. drive_invite_email placeholders: {name} {title} {position} {company} {date} {time} {venue} {location_link} {coordinator} {phone} {instructions}.

drive_invite_email.subject: Invitation: {title} on {date} — {company}

stage_on_interview_note: Owner, 21 Oct 2026: scheduling an interview moves a candidate who is still before this stage up to it, so the stage shown everywhere is the current status.
onboarding_notify_roles_note: Owner, 21 Oct 2026 flow: the login roles told (bell) when a joiner submits self-onboarding and when a background verification opens.
portals_note: Owner, 12 Oct 2026: the job portals HR posts on and downloads applicants from. `key` is also the candidate's source, so the source report shows what each portal brought. `how_to_post` and `how_to_download` are the steps shown on screen; portal menus change, so they are data here, not code. `post_url` opens the portal's employer sign-in.

portals.label: Naukri.com
portals.how_to_post: Sign in to Naukri Recruiter → Jobs → Post a Job. Paste each field below into the box with the same name, pick Industry and Department from Naukri's own lists, then Publish. Copy the Job ID Naukri shows and record it here under Mark as posted.
portals.how_to_download: Jobs → open the job → Responses. Tick all (or the ones you shortlisted) → Download → Excel. Import that file here as it is — no retyping.

portals.label: LinkedIn
portals.how_to_post: Sign in → Post a free job (or Jobs → Post a job). Job title, company, workplace type, location, employment type → paste the description → add up to 10 skills → Post.
portals.how_to_download: Jobs → Manage job posts → Applicants. A basic LinkedIn job post has no spreadsheet export: download each resume, or type the shortlisted few into the sample file. LinkedIn Recruiter can export a CSV — import it here.

portals.label: Indeed
portals.how_to_post: Sign in to Indeed for Employers → Post a job → fill the fields below in order → choose free or sponsored → Confirm.
portals.how_to_download: Candidates → filter the job → select all → Export candidates (CSV). Import that CSV here.

portals.label: foundit (Monster)
portals.how_to_post: Sign in to foundit Recruiter → Post Job → paste the fields → Publish.
portals.how_to_download: Responses → select → Download (Excel). Import it here.

portals.label: Shine.com
portals.how_to_post: Sign in to Shine Recruiter → Post a Job → paste the fields → Post.
portals.how_to_download: Applications → select → Download. Import it here.

portals.label: apna
portals.how_to_post: Good for tele-calling and field roles. Sign in → Post a job → title, salary, location, requirements → Post.
portals.how_to_download: Candidates → Download / Export Excel (on plans that allow it). Import it here.

portals.label: WorkIndia
portals.how_to_post: Sign in (app or web) → Post job → paste the fields → Post.
portals.how_to_download: Candidates → download the list where the plan allows; otherwise type the shortlisted ones into the sample file.

portals.label: Company website / careers email
portals.how_to_post: Use Download job post (Word) and put it on your careers page, WhatsApp groups, or send it to consultants.
portals.how_to_download: Collect applicants in the sample file (one row each) and import it.

import_columns_note: The column names each portal uses in its download, matched case-insensitively. Add a name here when a portal changes its spreadsheet; nothing else changes.
